fields.why: Level 0 (nativity only defines the family) is defensible, but the article also describes South Asian, Middle Eastern and African immigrant communities as surma users and multilingual warnings, i.e. nativity as a descriptor beyond the case population, which is level 1; A itself offered level 1 as its alternative.

Sex appears only through the word 'mother' (children's sex is not given), so recording it as a population dimension is harmless but not needed; both lists are acceptable and neither changes the level.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether nativity that defines a case-series family and is also used to describe the wider at-risk communities is 'population' (level 0) or 'descriptor' (level 1).
